summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives at Qatar commanding a 98-point lead over Max Verstappen, with Mercedes dominating early practice to reinforce their stranglehold on the drivers' and constructors' championships. George Russell shadows his world champion team-mate atop the timesheet, setting up a potential Mercedes 1-2 that could seal the constructor's title with one race remaining. A Qatar victory would move Antonelli to the brink of mathematical championship confirmation, leaving Abu Dhabi as a potential coronation rather than a fight.
